definition: Register search or case sampling only. No place is declared exhaustive or free of data-center permits.

statewide.scope: All statewide candidate rows returned by six published AZPDES GIS layers under the stated facility-name, narrative and two exact/locality-qualified alias screens. Not a statewide search of cities or drinking-water contracts.

areas.coverage: County air permit registry searched and one proposed county permit notice reviewed. Source classification limited to facility name/description and published P-number. Weekly applications, monthly issued reports, building permits for unincorporated county, and nonpoint-source dust permits not exhaustively searched.
Citywide project/description screen of the full city building register; state/county environmental matches reported separately.
Two public city GIS layers, permits and plan reviews. The source labels its permit dataset current/two years; matched rows can contain older issue dates. Not a complete historical archive.
Selected city Citizen Access records and one final city council decision; no comprehensive search by address or all Planned Area Development decisions.

Selected public Citizen Access records; excluded opaque building codes with no explicit facility term. Additional unacquired candidate URLs listed separately after the public portal rate-limited bulk access.

City-issued report screened for two county-documented facility parcels. Published only strict operator + parcel + address matches at a directly identified data center. Development purpose absent; these are not data-center zoning approvals. City notes its legacy active map excludes newer SPUR cases.
Official municipal issued-building-safety dataset, project names and work descriptions. Does not capture all prior or current projects.
Verified one Project Blue fugitive-dust enforcement action, related dust permit number, and statewide searches. No complete county permit export.
Commercial building layer searched, separate from the Pima County Project Blue site in unincorporated county.
One research-inventory point; no verified local permit included. Only statewide ADEQ text screen was performed here. A local permit decision, including a negative result, has not been established.

Each has one lab inventory point. State or county environmental registers searched as applicable; independent city building and zoning histories not collected. Absence of rows is not a no-permit determination.
